# CallPortTimeout

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

CallTimeout() that stores the reply length and any granted handle.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
Err CallPortTimeout(Handle port, uint32_t xlen, Handle grant_handle, Duration timeout, uint32_t *reply_len, Handle *reply_grant);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | in | Port handle with PERM_SEND. |
| `xlen` | in | Request length in bytes. |
| `grant_handle` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) to copy to the server, or -1. |
| `timeout` | in | Milliseconds to wait for the reply, or TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |
| `reply_len` | out | Receives the reply length; may be NULL. |
| `reply_grant` | out | Receives a handle granted back, or -1; may be NULL. |

## Returns

As CallTimeout().
